{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794678055313,"sessionID":"ses_e24de2449ffevFnIcj0E3TWf4S","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"4z2rUVf1l3J77Rxc","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/alpha_solver.py","content":"import numpy as np\n\ndef generate_alpha_points(num_points=1000):\n    # Generates points approximating an alpha shape tube\n    # Loop part (circle) and two tail parts\n    theta = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, int(num_points * 0.6))\n    R = 0.4\n    # Circle in xy plane\n    loop_x = R * np.cos(theta)\n    loop_y = R * np.sin(theta) + R\n    loop_z = np.zeros_like(theta)\n    \n    # Tails\n    t = np.linspace(0, 1.2, int(num_points * 0.2))\n    tail1_x = np.zeros_like(t) - R\n    tail1_y = R + t\n    tail1_z = np.zeros_like(t)\n    \n    tail2_x = np.zeros_like(t) + R\n    tail2_y = R + t\n    tail2_z = np.zeros_like(t)\n    \n    pts = np.vstack([\n        np.column_stack([loop_x, loop_y, loop_z]),\n        np.column_stack([tail1_x, tail1_y, tail1_z]),\n        np.column_stack([tail2_x, tail2_y, tail2_z])\n    ])\n    return pts\n\npts_a = generate_alpha_points()\nprint(\"Generated alpha shape with points:\", pts_a.shape)\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/alpha_solver.py","exists":true,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/alpha_solver.py","time":{"start":1794678055306,"end":1794678055311}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1db25e187001YpHQPUB03i0MKZ","sessionID":"ses_e24de2449ffevFnIcj0E3TWf4S","messageID":"msg_1db25d68d001bWlpxYT6hDRCz3"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794678061216,"sessionID":"ses_e24de2449ffevFnIcj0E3TWf4S","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"eGEuTQBvZbGr1Pf9","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"import numpy as np\n\ndef generate_alpha_points(num_points=500):\n    theta = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, int(num_points * 0.5))\n    R = 0.5\n    loop_x = R * np.cos(theta)\n    loop_y = R * np.sin(theta)\n    loop_z = np.zeros_like(theta)\n    \n    t = np.linspace(0, 1.0, int(num_points * 0.25))\n    tail1_x = -R + t * 0\n    tail1_y = R + t\n    tail1_z = np.zeros_like(t)\n    \n    tail2_x = R + t * 0\n    tail2_y = R + t\n    tail2_z = np.zeros_like(t)\n    \n    pts = np.vstack([\n        np.column_stack([loop_x, loop_y, loop_z]),\n        np.column_stack([tail1_x, tail1_y, tail1_z]),\n        np.column_stack([tail2_x, tail2_y, tail2_z])\n    ])\n    return pts\n\ndef rotation_matrix(axis, angle):\n    axis = axis / np.linalg.norm(axis)\n    a = np.cos(angle / 2.0)\n    b, c, d = -axis * np.sin(angle / 2.0)\n    return np.array([\n        [1-2*(c*c+d*d), 2*(b*c-a*d), 2*(b*d+a*c)],\n        [2*(b*c+a*d), 1-2*(b*b+d*d), 2*(c*d-a*b)],\n        [2*(b*d-a*c), 2*(c*d+a*b), 1-2*(b*b+c*c)]\n    ])\n\npts_a = generate_alpha_points()\nprint(\"Alpha points generated.\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/alpha_solver.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/alpha_solver.py","exists":true,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/alpha_solver.py","time":{"start":1794678061210,"end":1794678061214}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1db25f897001Y88XQ229xw5Cxp","sessionID":"ses_e24de2449ffevFnIcj0E3TWf4S","messageID":"msg_1db25ea0f0011TZpRdreXnIaGk"}}
